# Spain Wins the Padel World Cup: A Historic Double


by[Press](https://nomadar.com/author/press/)


| Nov 12, 2026


|[News](https://nomadar.com/category/news/) |[0 comments](https://nomadar.com/spain-wins-the-padel-world-cup-a-historic-double/#respond)


At Nomadar, we celebrate the historic double won by Spain’s national padel teams at the 2026 FIP World Cup. This success reflects what we believe in every day through our HPT (High Performance Training) program: talent grows with hard work, a good method, and commitment, starting from the ground up.


The men’s and women’s teams became world champions in Doha after beating Argentina in both finals, played at the Khalifa International Tennis & Squash Complex. The women’s team, led by Carolina Navarro and featuring players such as Paula Josemaría, Ariana Sánchez and Gemma Triay, reached the top of world padel once again.


The men’s team, with Juanjo Gutiérrez as head coach and Arturo Coello, Juan Lebrón and Paquito Navarro among its main players, won back the title after losing to Argentina in the finals of the last two editions.


Behind the trophies, there is more than famous names. Coaches, technical staff and the whole group worked in the same direction. It is also a generation of athletes who compete with character in the biggest moments. It is a way of understanding sport that we feel very close to.


At Nomadar and Cádiz CF, we support the development of Spanish sport with the same idea. Through our HPT program, young football players train with the Cádiz CF youth academy in a demanding environment, where both sports development and the values behind a career are taken care of. These values are effort, teamwork and consistency. Today’s big achievements begin with the work done from the ground up.


From here, congratulations to both teams for a week that is already part of Spanish sports history.
